newsitem.title: USA: Wackenhut selected for 480 bed facility.
newsitem.headline: Wackenhut selected for 480 bed facility.

text.p: Wackenhut Corrections said Monday it has been selected by the Michigan Department of Corrections to negotiate a contract for the design, construction and management of a 480-bed maximum security correctional facility for male juvenile offenders who have been sentenced as adults.

According to an announcement and news release by the MDOC, Wackenhut Corrections will be recommended to the state Administrative Board for approval of a contract to develop and operate the youth correctional facility near Baldwin, Michigan.
The announcement stated that the Joint Evaluation Committee "unanimously determined that Wackenhut was the preferred vendor."
